# qx_slugify :: 'Hello World'
import re
def qx_slugify(s):
    s = s.lower().strip()
    s = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9\s_-]', '', s)
    s = re.sub(r'[\s_-]+', '-', s).strip('-')
    return s

if __name__ == '__main__':
    print(qx_slugify('Hello World'))
